title: Outlets, extension cords and power strips

parts.label: Outlet
parts.looks: A wall receptacle with a cover plate.
parts.abnormal: Brown or black marks, melted plastic, cover plate missing with wiring visible.

parts.label: Cord or power strip
parts.looks: A flexible cord or a strip with several sockets.
parts.abnormal: Cut, frayed or taped insulation; bare conductors.

faults.name: Home-made or damaged cord
faults.evidence: Bare conductor ends, split jacket, or a strip opened up. If it is visibly not plugged in, it needs attention (replace it), not an emergency.

hazards.label: Scorched or melted outlet
hazards.threshold: Clear brown or black scorch or melting on an outlet or plug.

hazards.label: Bare wire on a powered circuit
hazards.threshold: Bare conductors in a wall box, panel or fixture, or on a cord that is plugged in. A cord that is visibly unplugged (cut end, no plug, lying on a bench) is attention, not escalation.

may: Unplug a damaged cord at the wall if the plug and hands are dry.
Stop using a warm outlet and leave it off.

tour.open: Show me the outlet or cord from about half a metre.
